title: Associate – U.S. Semiconductors and Networking Equity Research Analyst

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an Associate – U.S. Semiconductors and Networking Equity Research Analyst to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Equity Research Analysts provide formal independent investment recommendations to advisory clients via published reports and financial models. Their internal and external communication takes the form of written research reports, personal conversations and meetings, and media appearances.
The Associate will focus on supporting the coverage of the Semiconductors and Networking sector in the [Location masked]. The Associate will be responsible for assisting the Senior Equity Research Analyst in building, reviewing and maintaining financial databases and models, analyzing company and industry data, building an investment thesis, publishing investment-driven research reports and notes, and meeting with corporates, investors, media outlets as well as internally within the business.
The Associate will be expected to support the growth in coverage as part of the overall strategy to expand the footprint of [Company name masked] Research in the [Location masked]. The Associate will have exposure to corporates' management, investor conferences, analyst days and own the process of utilizing the available resources to make an investment recommendation. The Associate in conjunction with the Senior Equity Research Analyst will also work with teams within the firm, such as corporate access, research sales, specialist sales and trading.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in business, accounting, finance, economics, or related field of study
2-5 Years of experience in sell-side or buy-side financial stock analysis
Ability to analyze financial reports and business performance models
Detailed knowledge with financial modeling, stock analysis and valuation using Excel
FINRA Registrations: SIE, Series 63, 86, 87
Preferred Requirements
2-5 Years of experience in financial stock analysis in the [Location masked] Semiconductors and Networking sector
Expertise on using market data tools, such as FactSet, Bloomberg and S&P Capital IQ
CFA, CPA or international equivalent
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Candidates are measured on the following four performance drivers, which will dictate how individual impact is considered on the [Location masked] platform:
Results and Impact: Able to influence peers and team. Demonstrates good judgement when making decisions of high complexity and impact. Leadership and Collaboration: Creates trust with colleagues. Acts in leadership capacity for projects, processes, or programs. Client, Customer and Stakeholder Focus: Able to build relationships with a mix of colleagues and clients. Interacts regularly with management and department leaders. Equity Research Analysts provide formal independent investment recommendations to advisory clients via published reports and financial models. Their internal and external communication takes the form of written research reports, personal conversations and meetings, and media appearances.
The Associate will focus on supporting the coverage of the Semiconductors and Networking sector in the [Location masked]. The Associate will be responsible for assisting the Senior Equity Research Analyst in building, reviewing and maintaining financial databases and models, analyzing company and industry data, building an investment thesis, publishing investment-driven research reports and notes, and meeting with corporates, investors, media outlets as well as internally within the business.
The Associate will be expected to support the growth in coverage as part of the overall strategy to expand the footprint of [Company name masked] Research in the [Location masked]. The Associate will have exposure to corporates' management, investor conferences, analyst days and own the process of utilizing the available resources to make an investment recommendation. The Associate in conjunction with the Senior Equity Research Analyst will also work with teams within the firm, such as corporate access, research sales, specialist sales and trading.
cond_0623.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, economics, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in sell-side or buy-side financial stock analysis.
Strong command of financial report analysis and business performance modeling.
Deep knowledge of market data tools, such as FactSet, Bloomberg and S&P Capital IQ.
Advanced knowledge of financial modeling, stock analysis and valuation using Excel.
CFA, CPA or international equivalent.
Minimum 5 years of demonstrated expertise in financial stock analysis in the [Location masked] Semiconductors and Networking sector.
FINRA Registrations Required: SIE, Series 63, 86, 87.
cond_0623.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
